steps: Open a synthetic main contract; visit Estimate > Costs > Procurement > Shipments > KS; revisit each.
expected: Exactly 5 distinct live panes; no nested popup; no missing controls; each reloaded SQL snapshot.

steps: Edit a retail price; commit cell; immediately switch to Costs before Save status completes; return; reopen contract.
expected: Value is either verified by independent SQL readback or visibly unsaved; no silent loss/duplicate edit.

steps: Edit a fresh cell then press Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Y outside the TextBox editor; independently re-read SQL after each.
expected: Undo and redo agree with authoritative SQL; editor TextBox Ctrl+Z remains local.

steps: Use Insert, Shift+Insert, Ctrl+Shift+Insert, Ctrl+Alt+Insert, Ctrl+D, Delete, Backspace, Ctrl+M and Alt+Up/Down.
expected: Matching Python structure semantics, focus, confirmation and row ordering; no accidental removal of linked data.

steps: Lock synthetic contract with a signed act; attempt retail edit, structural delete and Undo.
expected: All forbidden changes rejected; original value, signed lines, history and revision remain intact.

steps: Search with Ctrl+F; change view/filter/column width; move to Procurement and back; close and reopen.
expected: Selection/focus and transient filter policy match Python; persisted column settings survive restart.

steps: Edit manually entered purchase and retail units; change view; compare row and summary totals.
expected: Manual prices retained; SQL money readback matches expected decimal rounding; no hidden overwrite.

steps: Change transport and SMR mode; navigate to KS and back; compare materials/work/markup.
expected: No silent mode conversion; refused unsafe transition does not mutate persisted monetary values.

steps: Filter by supplier, category, system and search; bulk-assign supplier and stage; reopen.
expected: Batch operation applied once only to selected contract rows; global revision/log and filters consistent.

steps: Record order/receipt movement; inspect movement history; revisit costs and issuance.
expected: Quantities and status reflected in independent SQL, no duplicate movements on navigation.

steps: Create out-of-KP purchase and linked DS on synthetic contract; check totals and cancel.
expected: Out-of-KP goods not billed in original KP/KS until intended DS conversion; no wrong FK.

steps: Create shipment, add eligible synthetic rows, recipient, issuer; export Excel/PDF and reopen.
expected: Document and SQL totals agree, no unexpected posted quantities.

steps: Post issuance, try to edit a posted quantity, delete posted list, reopen from second client.
expected: Posted rows remain immutable until explicit supported reversal; no negative stock or duplicate issue.

steps: Create draft KS-2; add 2 rows and extra position; save/readback; inspect KS-3.
expected: Act-line amounts and totals match SQL and document; remaining quantities correct.

steps: Sign synthetic KS; change underlying estimate price, act qty and delete act; repeat through another client.
expected: Signed act snapshot immutable; incorrect edit rejected without changing meta.rev or history.

steps: Export KS-2/KS-3 with group/systems/PNR and compare XLSX/PDF against Python golden.
expected: Money within kopeck and document fields/shape verified; do not infer PASS from creation.

steps: Object > KP > convert to main contract > create DS > archive > create remainder; reopen all nodes.
expected: Correct IDs, links, cards, permissions and archival visibility; no orphaned documents.

steps: Switch objects and documents with active filter and keyboard focus; use Ctrl+B, Ctrl+N, F2.
expected: Consistent selection and focus; no cross-object writes; shortcuts do not leak across tabs.

steps: Two live Windows clients edit same contract, same/different cells and supplier/status sequentially.
expected: Revision conflict visible; no lost update, deadlock or swallowed SQL rejection.

steps: Simulate disconnect/unknown COMMIT in disposable Pilot; reopen/readback before any retry.
expected: No blind reapply; reconciliation uses server snapshot/operation identity.

steps: On synthetic 300-line contract, edit, scroll and open all five panes.
expected: Baseline UI p50/p95/p99, screenshots and SQL proof captured.

steps: On synthetic 2500-line contract, edit, scroll, batch procurement, switch tabs, reopen.
expected: No frozen dispatcher or data corruption; record p50/p95/p99; compare against baseline.

steps: On synthetic 10000-line contract, filter, undo, navigate, two-client readback, reopen.
expected: All persisted data intact; measure latency/memory; no unexplained truncation.

steps: Close WPF with pending write, launch again with same synthetic Pilot and saved user settings.
expected: Unsaved warning respected; independently committed data visible; no phantom success.

steps: Produce Excel/PDF from procurement, issuance and KS; inspect generated files with synthetic identifiers.
expected: No real templates/archives touched; generated documents correspond to SQL snapshots.
